### Rubrik to Report Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results on November 30, 2026


November 11, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/667520861/files/doc_news/Rubrik-to-Report-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2027-Financial-Results-on-November-30-2026-2026.pdf)


PALO ALTO, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Rubrik, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rubrik.com%2F&esheet=54638851&newsitemid=20261111689088&lan=en-US&anchor=Rubrik%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=a8f1f35b144970fcb88c708345294f03) (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, today announces that it will release financial results for its third quarter fiscal 2027 ended October 31, 2026, after the market closes on Monday, November 30, 2026.


Management will also host a live conference call that day at 2:00 pm PT / 5:00 pm ET to discuss the Company’s financial results.


A live webcast of the conference call and related materials can be accessed from the Company’s investor relations website at[https://ir.rubrik.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.rubrik.com&esheet=54638851&newsitemid=20261111689088&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.rubrik.com&index=2&md5=2aee37396f145a2b59964d8c613319ae) . Following the call, a replay of the webcast will also be available on the investor relations website.


**About Rubrik**


Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls. For more information, please visit[www.rubrik.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.rubrik.com&esheet=54638851&newsitemid=20261111689088&lan=en-US&anchor=www.rubrik.com&index=3&md5=18f1ec6e9117fa8981b5daa09f1144ab) and follow Rubrik on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Frubrik-inc%2Fposts%2F&esheet=54638851&newsitemid=20261111689088&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=4&md5=d8a3ed4e56cfbce4c3bcfd4f56b5ba1a) and[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FrubrikInc&esheet=54638851&newsitemid=20261111689088&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=5&md5=e8cd532208a2635a30dcd053fb244cbf) .
